test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A man bought a chair for Rs. 580. At what price should he sell the chair so as to gain 25%
solution:
Given:

A man bought a chair for Rs. 580. 

Expected gain% = 25%

Concept used:

Selling Price = Cost Price × (1 + Gain%)

Calculation:

Now, the selling price should be

⇒ 580 × (1 + 25%)

⇒ Rs. 725

∴ He should sell the chair at Rs. 725 so as to gain 25%.
